title: Orthogonal Polynomials, a Szegő--Verblunsky Theorem and Baxter's Theorem on the Quaternionic Sphere
summary: We introduce a theory of orthogonal polynomials on the unit sphere of the quaternions based on the notion of a $q$-positive measure (which originated in a work of Alpay, Colombo, the second author and Sabadini). The results we extend to this setting include the Szegő recurrences, the Zeros Theorem for orthogonal polynomials, the Szegő--Verblunsky theorem, and Baxter's theorem; to obtain these results, we utilise the Verblunsky coefficients (or Schur parameters) of Alpay, Colombo and Sabadini and a number of established results in the matricial setting.
